name: Smoking Marijuana
overview: Scripture acknowledges that God has provided every herb and plant for human use, as seen in Genesis 1:29 and 9:3, indicating that plants are part of His provision for mankind. However, the Bible also warns against behaviors associated with excess and loss of self-control, such as drunkenness and riotous living (Proverbs 23:20; Romans 13:13; Ephesians 5:18). Believers are called to live honestly and be filled with the Spirit rather than indulging in practices that impair clear understanding and godly conduct (Matthew 15:10; Ephesians 5:18).
